quest.title: Little Lantern, Little Wish
quest.description: Mengmeng seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Xiao Lanterns are soooo hard to make...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Do you know how to make Xiao Lanterns? I keep trying but I can't do it...

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Through the hole, then back around, and then... I drop it. Or it breaks.

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: I really wanted to make a Xiao Lantern for Yu...

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Yu always has to look after the tea shop, so he never has any time to play or to make a lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: But I bet he still has a wish. So I wanna make a lantern for him...

choices.text: I can make one for you.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: But, but... I wanted to be the one to make it for him...

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: And, and... I wanna know the secrets to making them so I can tell Yu, too.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Could you... teach me how to make them?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: So, so... Then the Xiao Lantern is ready, right?

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Thanks! I'm gonna go make one for Yu now!

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: H—Hi... Sir or Madam, um, um... Please put your feet up, and please have some tea, and...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're here to give you a Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: ...Really?

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Yu, the Xiao Lantern's for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: Mengmeng? Oh, did you make this...? Wow... thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: #This {M#nice man}{F#nice lady} taught me how to make them. Actually, it's one of my first, so I didn't do a great job... D—Do you like it...?

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: Are you kidding? It's great, I love it! I was just starting to worry when I'd have the time to make one for myself...

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: Thanks, Mengmeng. I'll find someone to hang it on my door in a bit.

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Well, the thing is... My dad's not in great health, so he can't hang it up for me. And I'm too short, so I wouldn't be able to reach...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: So, if I wanna hang it on the door, I gotta ask someone around here if they can help...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Really? You sure you don't mind helping? ...That's great, thanks! Now I don't need to worry about who'd watch the shop if I went off looking for someone to help...

choices.text: Can't someone in your family help?

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: #This Xiao Lantern looks so pretty! Thanks so much, {M#Sir}{F#Ma'am}!

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Come on, Yu... Let's go and play. I know a great place with the prettiest flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: #This {M#nice man}{F#nice lady} taught me how to make Xiao Lanterns, and when we get there I can teach you, too. C'mon, wouldn't that be great?

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: I, uh... I can't. I need to watch the shop. Even though there's no customers, I've gotta keep the place spick and span, just like my dad always says.

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Okay, well... Scrap the Xiao Lanterns, how about we just go there, have a quick chat, then come back straight away? That way, it won't waste too much of your time.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: But...

choices.text: I can clean the shop for you.

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: ...Oh? Y—You sure? That, uh... That's asking a lot of you...

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: We'll be really quick, we'll just go straight there and come straight back. Promise it won't take too long!

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Thanks soooo much!

talks.objective: Eavesdrop on Yu and Mengmeng's conversation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like the two of them are still playing. Guess we don't have to worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But given the atmosphere... Maybe we shouldn't disturb them.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: If we made a garland for your dad, do you think he'd get better quicker?

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: I... I don't know...

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: I read in a book that if you stay happy, even if you get sick, you'll get better really quickly.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: I think that you're so grown-up, the way you help your dad watch the shop every day... And I'm sure that must make him very happy.

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: But sometimes he tells me off... "Stop lounging around in the shop, go off and play"...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: "If you don't go and play with Mengmeng, she'll pick the whole neighborhood bare of flowers"...

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: That would never happen, there's soooo many flowers around here... Wait a second, I'll make a garland for you.

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Thanks, Mengmeng. I should be getting back.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Huh, okay... Well, once your dad's recovered, you'll have more time, right? Then I can come play with you again...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Yep, I'm sure dad will make a quick recovery...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: What the...!? Wh—When did you get here?

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Uhh... Uhhhh... I—I...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite to you, too!

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Ha—Happy Lantern Rite...

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Um, well, thanks for your help. Please take these as a thank-you. Dad says that you should always give people something in return for their help.

response.speaker: Yu
response.text: Let's head back to the shop... Come on, Mengmeng.

response.speaker: Mengmeng
response.text: Yep, let's head back. Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Mengmeng
dialogues.text: Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help...
